firm_data.firm_description: The New York Times Company is a media organization with a mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world through independent journalism and digital products.
notable_facts: The New York Times has been delivering world-class journalism for nearly 170 years.
The company has nearly seven million subscribers using The New York Times to read news, enjoy games, try recipes, and listen to podcasts.
The New York Times Company is focused on becoming a world-class digital media business.
